notes: Conventions example (mw-e39.3), not shipped: the class-variant pattern of docs/narrative/content-conventions.md. One entry per class greeting (entry ids `first-<class>`, node ids `greet-<class>`), a return entry chosen by dialogue.visitedCount, an unconditioned fallback, and class-gated options with the class in the option id. Ottilie Marsh, story bible 5.15. Real conversations are written under E39.

nodes.speaker: ottilie
nodes.text: Armour on a Tuesday. Mind the step; the bridge stones are slick, and I'd rather you didn't scrape my doorframe.

nodes.speaker: ottilie
nodes.text: Green cloak, bow, muddy boots. The Briarwood sends its regards. Wipe them, please.

nodes.speaker: ottilie
nodes.text: You'll be wanting Mirela's shop, not mine. Mine has gloves, though, and ink does stain.

nodes.speaker: ottilie
nodes.text: Light on your feet. Good. The scales are honest and so is the till; I count it twice.

nodes.speaker: ottilie
nodes.text: Mind the step. Ottilie Marsh. First shop past the bridge, and the scales are honest, whatever you've heard.

nodes.speaker: ottilie
nodes.text: Back again, and in one piece. That's more than I can say for my hinges.

options.text: I keep the watch on the bridge for a night's lodging. Has anyone crossed who shouldn't?
Have you seen wolf tracks by the bridge?

nodes.speaker: ottilie
nodes.text: Wolves, no. Mags Oakum's barge has gone down the river empty twice this week, and she hates running empty.
